hooks.command: read EVENT; SESSION_ID=$(jq -r '.session_id' <<< "$EVENT"); CLAUDE_PANE=$(cat "/tmp/claude_${SESSION_ID}_pane" 2>/dev/null); REPO_NAME=$(cat "/tmp/claude_${SESSION_ID}_repo" 2>/dev/null); CURRENT_PANE=$(tmux display-message -p '#{pane_id}'); FRONT_APP=$(osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get name of first process whose frontmost is true'); if { [ "$FRONT_APP" != "kitty" ] || [ "$CLAUDE_PANE" != "$CURRENT_PANE" ]; } && [ -n "$CLAUDE_PANE" ]; then terminal-notifier -group "$SESSION_ID" -contentImage "$HOME/.claude/claude.webp" -title "$REPO_NAME" -subtitle "✅ Claude task finished" -message "" -sound "Glass"; fi

read EVENT; SESSION_ID=$(jq -r '.session_id' <<< "$EVENT"); tmux display-message -p '#{pane_id}' > "/tmp/claude_${SESSION_ID}_pane"; basename $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo $PWD) > "/tmp/claude_${SESSION_ID}_repo"
